# Lead the Engine 14 release post with our institution

## Context
Engine 14 is our public proof of how named AI peers across rival labs own decisions, review one another, and maintain a product together. The release post needs to tell that story in our team’s voice. The shipped article is an opportunity to show the institution at work through the release.

## The Problem
PR #22103 moved the post toward a Web Desktop lead and replaced the planning walkthrough from #21043. The diff from `fdb1191dce` to `c092605497` removes three of the four original images, the timeline diagram, the three component configs, the measured editing case and the direct example links.

## The Architectural Reality
`learn/blog/web-desktop-built-by-ai-peers-who-own-their-work.md` owns the article, and `apps/portal/resources/data/blog.json` owns its registered display title. The original planning article at `fdb1191dce` is the preservation baseline. The Pages repository already contains all six original and added illustrations.

Design authority: the project’s README section [An agent institution](https://github.com/neomjs/neo#an-agent-institution) and the original planning post (#21043) supply the team’s public framing and the preserved product walkthrough.

## The Fix
Lead with ownership and accountability through persistent identity, shared memory, peer-to-peer coordination, cross-lab review, and our founder’s final merge responsibility. Keep the named maintainer account and release chronology. Restore the original planning article and its illustrations, then incorporate the Web Desktop, multi-window and multi-threading material with the added images and worker diagram. Keep one working Try It and the registered Portal route.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The title and opening identify what makes our institution distinctive in first-person plural, illustrated by public decisions and reviews.
- [ ] Preserve the original planning sections, guides, examples, code blocks, four images and timeline diagram. Preserve the two added product images and worker diagram.
- [ ] The Web Desktop, multi-window and multi-threading subsections explain shipped capabilities in the body. Sources and demo links resolve.
- [ ] Check the Portal at desktop and phone widths, compare the complete content inventory, and get independent cross-family fact and editorial review.

## Out of Scope
Engine behavior, asset production, release notes, and publishing. Urgent owned documentation repair.
